newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA CHEMICAL EXPORTS UP 22.7 PERCENT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: CHINA CHEMICAL EXPORTS UP 22.7 PERCENT IN H1.

text.p: China's exports of chemical products in the first half rose 22.7 percent from the same period last year to $6.71 billion, the China Chemical Industry News said on Friday.
Exports of chemical products in January-June accounted for 8.3 percent of total exports, it said.
Imports of chemical products in the first half were $9.21 billion, down 0.6 percent year-on-year and accounting for 14.6 percent of total imports, it said.
Imports of chemical products in the first six months outstripped exports by $2.5 billion, compared with $3.8 billion for the same period last year, it said.

Total imports and exports of chemical products in the first half rose to $15.93 billion, up 8.1 percent compared with the same period last year and accounting for 11.1 percent of total trade in the period, it said.

In January-June, exports of inorganic chemical materials totalled $1.11 billion, up 18.1 percent year-on-year, while exports of organic chemical materials were $1.15 billion, up 13.9 percent year-on-year, it said.
Exports of pesticides in the period were $170 million, up 21.4 percent year-on-year, while exports of paints, dyes and pigments totalled $410 million, up 32.2 percent year-on-year, it said.
